title: Rubric rewards
brief: Build a recall-style rubric grader and a precision-style claims grader, find the optimal subset of claims under their mix, and train an exact policy gradient to the per-claim threshold.
hints: A false claim is one where truth is 0, so the claims reward counts include * (1 - truth). Dropping the (1 - truth) factor penalizes true claims too, and the model learns to say nothing.
Expected reward is linear in the inclusion vector: the sum of include * (alpha * w - beta * c * (1 - p)). Include claim i exactly when that bracket is positive.
With q = sigmoid(theta), the exact gradient of the expected reward is g * q * (1 - q), where g is the bracket. Check it against finite differences of expected_reward(sigmoid(theta), ...).
